messages:
Tyler Nguyen: quick heads-up — PR #24501 is ready to land but macOS e2e has been flapping. small change (routing fallback + a unit test tweak). deploy freeze starts 00:00 UTC on 03/22. can we do a staggered canary or should we delay?
Maria Lopez: @Tyler can you paste the failing snippet? if it's just a flake we can canary.
ci-bot: mac-e2e failure on job `mac-e2e-202` (attempt 3) — timeout in test `session_restore`. last lines:```
[2026-03-17T18:12:03Z] ERROR: session timeout after 120s
[2026-03-17T18:12:03Z] INFO: dumping logs to /artifacts/24501/session_restore.log
[2026-03-17T18:12:03Z] FAIL: session_restore (timed out)
```
Samir Patel: I can take eyes this afternoon. Does this PR touch DB migrations or schema?
Tyler Nguyen: no migrations, no schema. purely routing + a small cache control tweak. safe for canary in my opinion.
Maria Lopez: propose: staggered canary -> land to canary-1, monitor 15m, then promote. Who can run the canary and watch logs?
Ops Pager: canary slot available at ~20:00 PT today. deploy freeze still at 00:00 UTC. if you start by 19:30 PT you should have margin for a rollback.
Samir Patel: I can run the canary and monitor. @ci-bot please rerun mac-e2e for pr/24501 so we get a fresh green before we push to canary.
ci-bot: Rerun triggered: https://ci.internal/redwood/pr/24501/build/789
ci-bot: Status: queued (mac-e2e-202 rerun)
Maria Lopez: small reminder: keep the canary window restricted to canary-1 only (no global traffic) until we confirm perf and error rates.
ci-bot: mac-e2e rerun completed — PASS (all attempts). windows-e2e: PASS. staging-smoke: PASS.
Samir Patel: running canary-1 deploy now. will keep an eye on 200/500 rate, latencies, and memory.
Tyler Nguyen: thanks Samir. requesting approvals: @Maria, @Jordan — can you give an approve if you're good?
Jordan Park: approved — left one tiny nit inline but non-blocking.
Maria Lopez: approved. watched the canary metrics for 20m, no regressions.
Tyler Nguyen: merging in ~10m unless objections. rollback plan: if we see errors >0.5% or latency regresses >20% in the canary window, revoke traffic and rollback to commit for PR #24500, and pin model routing to previous variant.
Samir Patel: ack. will post logs and a short summary after 30m observation.
Tyler Nguyen: merging now. thanks everyone :rocket:
Samir Patel: can confirm steady metrics at +30m — promoting to staged traffic. all good.
Tyler Nguyen: excellent — marking as landed and noting in release notes.
Maria Lopez: nice one, team :thumbsup:
